tests.title: The platform versions the app is built on are recorded

steps.action: Compare the recorded Expo, Expo Router, React Native, React and TypeScript versions with the installed ones
steps.expected: Each recorded version is the installed one

steps.action: Compare the recorded Android versions with the app's build settings
steps.expected: The oldest supported Android is 12 (API 31), and the target and compile SDK are the ones the build uses

tests.title: The installed app asks for no network permission

steps.action: Generate the release build's manifest from the app's configuration
steps.expected: It removes the Internet, network state and Wi-Fi state permissions

steps.action: Read the permissions of the release APK built by `AC-01-01-5` with `aapt dump permissions`
steps.expected: No `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` or `ACCESS_WIFI_STATE`

tests.title: The app starts and runs with the device's network switched off

steps.action: Switch the emulator's network off (airplane mode)
steps.expected: The network is off

tests.title: The release APK is signed with a key kept outside the repository

steps.action: Generate the app's build configuration and read the release build type
steps.expected: It is signed with the release signing configuration, not the debug key

steps.action: Read the release signing configuration
steps.expected: The keystore, alias and passwords come from the `KQ_UPLOAD_*` environment variables or Gradle properties, an environment variable winning over the property of the same name (`DEC-45`), nothing from the repository

steps.action: Read what a release build does when those properties are missing
steps.expected: It fails and names the missing properties

steps.action: Build the release APK with a throwaway key passed only through the `KQ_UPLOAD_*` environment variables
steps.expected: The build succeeds and writes `app-release.apk`

steps.action: Verify the APK's signature with `apksigner verify --print-certs`
steps.expected: It verifies, and its certificate is the throwaway key's, not the debug key's

steps.action: Read the APK's minimum SDK with `aapt dump badging`
steps.expected: `sdkVersion:'31'` — Android 12 and newer only (`NFR-10`)
